scenarios.name: Crash before persistence
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: synchronous ingestion must not acknowledge a record absent from SQLite.

scenarios.name: Crash after persistence
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: SQLite record must remain durable across API process termination.

scenarios.name: Crash before HTTP submission
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: publisher state is persisted before outbound webhook submission.

scenarios.name: Crash during submission
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: synchronous HTTP call may be interrupted while request is in flight.

scenarios.name: Remote acceptance before local receipt
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: remote acceptance can precede local receipt persistence; delivery is at-least-once/ambiguous, not exactly-once.

scenarios.name: Restart with pending records
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: pending approval and durable delivery rows survive API restart.

scenarios.name: Restart with ambiguous records
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: ambiguous delivery state must not be blindly retried if contract forbids it.

scenarios.name: Concurrent worker claims
scenarios.applicability: Not applicable as worded: no worker/claim queue exists; API concurrency/SQLite claim exclusion requires separately approved remapping, not substituted here.

scenarios.name: Duplicate event submission
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: stable event IDs and durable ledger implement duplicate suppression.

scenarios.name: Discord 429
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: synchronous publisher handles rate-limit response/retry metadata.

scenarios.name: Discord 5xx
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: synchronous publisher handles remote server failure and ambiguous state.

scenarios.name: Network interruption
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: outgoing HTTP transport failure during synchronous delivery.

scenarios.name: Database interruption
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: SQLite is the durable persistence backend.

scenarios.name: Dead-letter transition
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: publisher transitions eligible terminal failures to its local JSONL dead-letter record.

scenarios.name: Authorized replay
scenarios.applicability: Applicable: IAM-protected replay API is part of the integration contract.

scenarios.name: Worker restart during retry
scenarios.applicability: Not applicable as worded: there is no worker process; analogous API process interruption during synchronous retry is not silently substituted.

scenarios.name: Configuration reload
scenarios.applicability: Applicable only to the integration's supported reload path; implementation contract needs confirmation before fault assertion.

scenarios.name: Queue reconciliation after process termination
scenarios.applicability: Not applicable as worded: no queue exists; SQLite stale-delivery reconciliation is a distinct behavior and is not silently substituted.

architecture_gap: Current implementation is synchronous and has no queue or worker. Queue-specific historic scenarios remain listed as authoritative requirements but cannot be substituted with unrelated cases.
